arp_acl_block.cause: ARP traffic blocked by an ACL
arp_acl_block.reason: A filtering policy blocks ARP resolution required to reach the next hop.

identify.command: Inspect ACLs and ip neigh show
identify.expected_evidence: A rule blocks ARP or neighbor resolution remains incomplete.

resolution: Permit required ARP traffic.

verification.command: ip neigh show; ping <peer>
verification.expected_result: The neighbor resolves and responds.

arp_cache_poisoning.reason: An IP address is mapped to an unauthorized MAC address.

identify.command: ip neigh show; arp -n
identify.expected_evidence: The affected IP maps to an unexpected or changing MAC.

resolution: Remove the poisoned entry and stop unauthorized ARP advertisements.

verification.command: Monitor ip neigh and ping the gateway
verification.expected_result: The legitimate mapping remains stable.

bgp_acl_block.cause: BGP traffic blocked by an ACL
bgp_acl_block.reason: A filtering rule prevents TCP port 179 traffic between BGP peers.

identify.command: show ip bgp summary; inspect ACLs for TCP/179
identify.expected_evidence: The session is not Established and peer traffic is denied.

resolution: Permit the intended BGP peer traffic.

verification.command: show ip bgp summary
verification.expected_result: The peer reaches Established.

bgp_asn_misconfig.reason: The local or remote AS differs from the intended peer relationship.

identify.command: show running-config | section bgp; show ip bgp summary
identify.expected_evidence: An AS value is inconsistent and the peer is not Established.

resolution: Correct the local or remote BGP AS.

verification.command: show ip bgp summary; show ip route bgp
verification.expected_result: The peer is Established and expected routes are installed.

bgp_blackhole_route_leak.reason: An unintended discard route is advertised beyond its intended scope.

identify.command: show ip bgp; show ip route; inspect export policy
identify.expected_evidence: An affected prefix is exported with an unintended discard next hop.

resolution: Withdraw the leaked route and correct export policy.

verification.command: show ip bgp; traceroute <prefix>
verification.expected_result: The leaked route is absent and traffic uses a valid path.

bgp_hijacking.reason: An unauthorized origin or path is selected for an affected prefix.

identify.command: show ip bgp <prefix>
identify.expected_evidence: The selected origin AS, AS path, or next hop is unexpected.

resolution: Reject the unauthorized advertisement and enforce route validation.

verification.command: show ip bgp <prefix>; traceroute <prefix>
verification.expected_result: Only the authorized route is selected.

bgp_missing_route_advertisement.reason: The intended prefix is omitted by the BGP network or export configuration.

identify.command: show running-config | section bgp; show ip bgp
identify.expected_evidence: The intended local prefix is absent from advertisements.

resolution: Add the intended network advertisement or correct export policy.

verification.command: show ip bgp; show ip route bgp
verification.expected_result: Peers receive and install the prefix.

bmv2_switch_down.reason: The software switch process is unavailable.

identify.command: Check the BMv2 process and query tables
identify.expected_evidence: The process or control API is unavailable.

resolution: Correct the startup failure and restart BMv2.

verification.command: Query tables and repeat traffic
verification.expected_result: The switch responds and forwards traffic.

dhcp_missing_subnet.reason: The DHCP server has no matching pool for the client network.

identify.command: Inspect DHCP configuration and logs
identify.expected_evidence: No subnet declaration matches the client relay/network.

resolution: Add the intended subnet, pool, gateway, and options.

verification.command: Renew the client lease
verification.expected_result: The client receives valid addressing information.

dhcp_service_down.reason: The DHCP daemon is not serving requests.

identify.command: systemctl status <dhcp-service>; ss -lunp
identify.expected_evidence: The daemon is failed/inactive or not listening.

resolution: Correct the failure and start the DHCP service.

verification.command: Renew a client lease
verification.expected_result: The client receives the intended lease.

dhcp_spoofed_dns.cause: DHCP supplied a spoofed DNS server
dhcp_spoofed_dns.reason: A client received an unauthorized resolver through DHCP.

identify.command: Inspect the lease and /etc/resolv.conf
identify.expected_evidence: The resolver differs from the authorized server.

resolution: Remove the rogue DHCP source and restore the DNS option.

verification.command: Renew the lease and resolve a known name
verification.expected_result: The authorized resolver returns the expected record.

dhcp_spoofed_gateway.reason: A client installed an unauthorized gateway received through DHCP.

identify.command: Inspect the lease and ip route
identify.expected_evidence: The default route uses an unauthorized gateway.

resolution: Remove the rogue DHCP source and restore the router option.

verification.command: Renew the lease; ip route; traceroute <target>
verification.expected_result: Traffic uses the intended gateway.

dns_lookup_latency.reason: DNS queries experience abnormal delay despite eventual responses.

identify.command: Time dig queries and inspect path statistics
identify.expected_evidence: DNS query time exceeds the expected threshold.

resolution: Remove path delay or restore resolver capacity.

verification.command: Repeat timed DNS lookups
verification.expected_result: Latency remains within the expected threshold.

dns_port_blocked.reason: A filtering rule prevents UDP or TCP port 53 traffic.

identify.command: Inspect ACLs and test dig over UDP/TCP
identify.expected_evidence: IP reachability exists but DNS traffic is denied or times out.

resolution: Permit intended DNS traffic on UDP and TCP port 53.

verification.command: dig <known-name>
verification.expected_result: The resolver returns the expected answer.

dns_record_error.reason: The authoritative record differs from the intended service mapping.

identify.command: dig <name> +noall +answer
identify.expected_evidence: The returned value differs from the intended target.

resolution: Correct the zone record and reload DNS.

verification.command: dig <name>; test the resolved service
verification.expected_result: The intended record and service are available.

dns_service_down.reason: The DNS daemon is not running or listening.

identify.command: systemctl status <dns-service>; ss -lntup | grep :53
identify.expected_evidence: The daemon is failed/inactive or port 53 is not listening.

resolution: Correct the failure and start DNS.

verification.command: dig @<server> <known-name>
verification.expected_result: The server returns the expected answer.

flow_rule_loop.reason: Forwarding rules send affected traffic through a repeating path.

identify.command: traceroute <destination>; inspect forwarding rules
identify.expected_evidence: Nodes or next hops repeat until TTL expires.

resolution: Correct next-hop rules so the path progresses.

verification.command: traceroute and ping the destination
verification.expected_result: The path has no loop and reaches the destination.

flow_rule_shadowing.reason: A broader or higher-priority rule prevents the intended rule from matching.

identify.command: Inspect ordered rules and counters
identify.expected_evidence: An earlier rule covers the intended match.

resolution: Correct rule scope or priority.

verification.command: Inspect counters and repeat traffic
verification.expected_result: The intended rule receives hits.

frr_service_down.reason: The routing daemon cannot maintain adjacencies or routes.

identify.command: systemctl status frr
identify.expected_evidence: FRR is failed or inactive.

resolution: Correct the failure and start FRR.

verification.command: systemctl status frr; show ip route
verification.expected_result: FRR is active and routes converge.

host_crash.reason: The host is unavailable and exposes no normal network state.

identify.command: Check host state and direct reachability
identify.expected_evidence: The host is stopped or unresponsive.

resolution: Restore the host and correct the crash condition.

verification.command: Check host state; ping the gateway; test its service
verification.expected_result: The host remains healthy and reachable.

host_incorrect_dns.reason: The host uses a resolver different from the intended DNS service.

identify.command: cat /etc/resolv.conf
identify.expected_evidence: The nameserver differs from the authorized resolver.

resolution: Configure the intended resolver manually or through DHCP.

verification.command: Inspect resolv.conf and resolve a known name
verification.expected_result: The intended resolver returns the correct answer.

host_incorrect_gateway.reason: The default route points to a next hop inconsistent with the attached subnet.

identify.command: ip route
identify.expected_evidence: The default route points to the wrong next hop.

resolution: Configure the intended gateway.

verification.command: ip route; ping <gateway>
verification.expected_result: The intended gateway is configured and reachable.

host_incorrect_ip.reason: The address does not belong to the intended subnet.

identify.command: ip -4 address
identify.expected_evidence: The address differs from the addressing plan.

resolution: Configure the intended IP address.

verification.command: ip -4 address; ping <gateway>
verification.expected_result: The intended address is present and usable.

host_incorrect_netmask.reason: The prefix length is inconsistent with the intended subnet.

identify.command: ip -4 address
identify.expected_evidence: The prefix length differs from the plan.

resolution: Configure the intended prefix length.

verification.command: ip -4 address; ip route
verification.expected_result: The intended prefix and connected route are present.

host_ip_conflict.reason: Multiple devices claim the same address and destabilize neighbor resolution.

identify.command: arping -D <address>; ip neigh show
identify.expected_evidence: Multiple MAC addresses claim the same IP.

resolution: Assign unique IP addresses and remove duplicate allocation.

verification.command: arping -D <address>; monitor ip neigh
verification.expected_result: Only one stable mapping remains.

host_missing_ip.reason: The affected interface has no usable IPv4 address.

identify.command: ip -4 address
identify.expected_evidence: No intended IPv4 address is assigned.

resolution: Restore the static address or DHCP assignment.

verification.command: ip -4 address; ping <gateway>
verification.expected_result: The intended address is assigned and usable.

host_static_blackhole.cause: Static blackhole route on a host
host_static_blackhole.reason: A discard route covers the affected destination.

identify.command: ip route show table all
identify.expected_evidence: A blackhole or unreachable route covers the target.

resolution: Remove the unintended discard route or restore the next hop.

verification.command: ip route get <destination>; ping <destination>
verification.expected_result: A valid next hop is selected.

host_vpn_membership_missing.reason: The host is absent from the required VPN or VRF routing context.

identify.command: Inspect interfaces, VRFs/namespaces, and routes
identify.expected_evidence: The required VPN attachment is absent.

resolution: Attach the host to the intended VPN/VRF.

verification.command: Inspect membership and test an in-VPN target
verification.expected_result: The host reaches allowed VPN destinations.

http_acl_block.cause: HTTP traffic blocked by an ACL
http_acl_block.reason: A filtering rule prevents the intended HTTP connection.

identify.command: curl -v <service>; inspect ACLs
identify.expected_evidence: HTTP is denied despite basic path reachability.

resolution: Permit intended client-to-service HTTP traffic.

verification.command: curl <service>
verification.expected_result: The expected HTTP response is returned.

icmp_acl_block.cause: ICMP traffic blocked by an ACL
icmp_acl_block.reason: A filtering rule denies required ICMP messages.

identify.command: Inspect ACLs and run ping/traceroute
identify.expected_evidence: ICMP is explicitly denied on an otherwise available path.

resolution: Permit the required ICMP types.

verification.command: ping and traceroute the destination
verification.expected_result: The required ICMP exchange succeeds.

incast_traffic_network_limitation.reason: Many simultaneous senders overwhelm a shared receiver path or queue.

identify.command: Inspect queue counters during concurrent flows
identify.expected_evidence: Drops or latency spike at a shared bottleneck.

resolution: Reduce burst synchronization or increase/shape bottleneck capacity.

verification.command: Repeat concurrent traffic
verification.expected_result: Loss and latency meet targets.

link_bandwidth_throttling.reason: A rate limit constrains throughput below intended capacity.

identify.command: tc -s qdisc show; run iperf
identify.expected_evidence: A policer/shaper matches the throughput ceiling.

resolution: Remove or correct the unintended rate limit.

verification.command: Run iperf and inspect qdisc counters
verification.expected_result: Throughput reaches the intended range.

link_detach.reason: The interface is no longer attached to the expected peer or bridge.

identify.command: ip link show; inspect topology attachment
identify.expected_evidence: The expected attachment is absent.

resolution: Reattach the interface to the intended link.

verification.command: ip link show; ping <peer>
verification.expected_result: The attachment exists and the peer responds.

link_down.reason: The interface has no operational link.

identify.command: ip link show; ethtool <interface>
identify.expected_evidence: The interface reports DOWN or no carrier.

resolution: Restore the interface and underlying link.

verification.command: ip link show; ping <peer>
verification.expected_result: The interface is UP and the peer responds.

link_flap.reason: The link repeatedly transitions between up and down.

identify.command: Inspect link-event logs and counters over time
identify.expected_evidence: Repeated carrier transitions occur.

resolution: Correct the condition causing repeated transitions.

verification.command: Monitor link state and counters
verification.expected_result: The link remains continuously UP.

link_fragmentation_disabled.reason: Oversized packets cannot be fragmented across the path.

identify.command: Test varying packet sizes and DF; inspect MTU
identify.expected_evidence: Small packets pass while oversized packets fail.

resolution: Restore fragmentation or correct path MTU/MSS.

verification.command: Repeat sized ping and application traffic
verification.expected_result: Intended packet sizes cross the path.

link_high_packet_corruption.cause: High packet corruption on a link
link_high_packet_corruption.reason: Interface error counters indicate damaged frames or packets.

identify.command: ethtool -S <interface>; ip -s link
identify.expected_evidence: CRC, frame, RX, or TX errors increase abnormally.

resolution: Correct the faulty medium, endpoint, or corruption source.

verification.command: Monitor errors while sending traffic
verification.expected_result: Errors stop increasing and loss normalizes.

load_balancer_overload.reason: Resource or connection capacity is exhausted by offered load.

identify.command: Inspect resources, connections, backlog, and HTTP latency
identify.expected_evidence: Saturation coincides with failed or slow requests.

resolution: Reduce load, add capacity, or correct the limiting setting.

verification.command: Repeat HTTP load while monitoring resources
verification.expected_result: Requests meet availability and latency targets.

mac_address_conflict.reason: The same MAC appears on multiple endpoints and destabilizes forwarding.

identify.command: Inspect interface MACs, FDB, and neighbor tables
identify.expected_evidence: One MAC moves between unexpected ports/endpoints.

resolution: Assign unique MAC addresses and clear stale entries.

verification.command: Monitor the FDB and repeat connectivity
verification.expected_result: Each MAC remains on one expected port.

mpls_label_limit_exceeded.reason: The device cannot install labels because table capacity is exhausted.

identify.command: Inspect label-table occupancy and logs
identify.expected_evidence: The label table is full and new entries fail.

resolution: Remove stale labels, reduce demand, or increase capacity.

verification.command: Inspect occupancy and install the required label
verification.expected_result: The label installs and traffic forwards.

ospf_acl_block.cause: OSPF traffic blocked by an ACL
ospf_acl_block.reason: A filtering rule blocks OSPF protocol 89 between neighbors.

identify.command: show ip ospf neighbor; inspect ACLs for protocol 89
identify.expected_evidence: The adjacency is absent/not FULL and OSPF is denied.

resolution: Permit OSPF between intended neighbors.

verification.command: show ip ospf neighbor; show ip route ospf
verification.expected_result: The adjacency is FULL and routes are installed.

ospf_area_misconfiguration.reason: Connected OSPF interfaces use inconsistent area IDs.

identify.command: show running-config | section ospf; show ip ospf neighbor
identify.expected_evidence: The endpoints use different areas and are not FULL.

resolution: Configure both ends in the intended area.

verification.command: show ip ospf neighbor; show ip route ospf
verification.expected_result: The adjacency is FULL and routes are installed.

ospf_neighbor_missing.reason: An intended interface or router is not participating in OSPF.

identify.command: show ip ospf interface; show ip ospf neighbor
identify.expected_evidence: The intended interface/network or neighbor is absent.

resolution: Enable the intended interface/network with compatible settings.

verification.command: show ip ospf neighbor; show ip route ospf
verification.expected_result: The neighbor is FULL and routes are installed.

p4_compilation_error_parser_state.reason: An invalid parser state or transition prevents compilation/loading.

identify.command: Compile/read P4 and inspect compiler logs
identify.expected_evidence: An error identifies a parser state or transition.

resolution: Correct the parser state/transition and rebuild.

verification.command: Compile, load, and send a test packet
verification.expected_result: The program loads and parses the packet.

p4_header_definition_error.reason: A malformed header declaration prevents correct compilation or parsing.

identify.command: Inspect P4 source and compiler log
identify.expected_evidence: An invalid field, width, or declaration is reported.

resolution: Correct the header and dependent references.

verification.command: Compile, load, and send a test packet
verification.expected_result: Compilation succeeds and the header parses.

p4_table_entry_misconfig.reason: A match, priority, action, or parameter differs from policy.

identify.command: Dump the relevant BMv2 table
identify.expected_evidence: The affected entry differs from the intended match/action.

resolution: Replace the entry with the intended match/action.

verification.command: Dump the table and repeat traffic
verification.expected_result: The corrected entry forwards traffic.

p4_table_entry_missing.cause: Required P4 table entry is missing
p4_table_entry_missing.reason: The forwarding table lacks an entry required for affected traffic.

identify.command: Dump the relevant BMv2 table
identify.expected_evidence: The required match/action entry is absent.

resolution: Install the intended match/action entry.

verification.command: Dump the table and repeat traffic
verification.expected_result: The entry exists and traffic forwards.

receiver_resource_contention.reason: The destination is resource-saturated and cannot process incoming traffic.

identify.command: Inspect receiver resources, sockets, and throughput
identify.expected_evidence: Receiver saturation coincides with degradation.

resolution: Reduce contention or add receiver capacity.

verification.command: Repeat traffic while monitoring the receiver
verification.expected_result: Performance meets targets without saturation.

sdn_controller_crash.cause: SDN controller is down or crashed
sdn_controller_crash.reason: The controller cannot program or manage the data plane.

identify.command: Check controller service/process and logs
identify.expected_evidence: The controller is stopped, failed, or crashing.

resolution: Correct the crash condition and restart the controller.

verification.command: Check controller health and switch sessions
verification.expected_result: The controller is healthy and switches reconnect.

sender_application_delay.reason: The application delays transmission before packets enter the network.

identify.command: Compare application timing with network RTT
identify.expected_evidence: Delay occurs before network transmission.

resolution: Correct the application-side delay or dependency.

verification.command: Repeat the transaction and inspect timing
verification.expected_result: Send delay returns to the expected range.

sender_resource_contention.reason: The source is resource-saturated and cannot generate traffic at the intended rate.

identify.command: Inspect sender resources, sockets, and throughput
identify.expected_evidence: Sender saturation coincides with degradation.

resolution: Reduce contention or add sender capacity.

verification.command: Repeat traffic while monitoring the sender
verification.expected_result: Performance meets targets without saturation.

southbound_port_block.reason: Filtering prevents switch-to-controller communication on the required port.

identify.command: Test the controller port and inspect ACLs
identify.expected_evidence: IP works but the southbound port is denied or times out.

resolution: Permit intended southbound traffic.

verification.command: Test the port and inspect controller sessions
verification.expected_result: The switch establishes its controller session.

southbound_port_mismatch.reason: The switch and controller use different transport ports.

identify.command: Inspect controller listen ports and switch configuration
identify.expected_evidence: The configured and listening ports differ.

resolution: Configure both sides to use the same port.

verification.command: Inspect the controller connection
verification.expected_result: The switch establishes the intended session.

web_dos_attack.reason: Abnormal connection/request volume exhausts web-service resources.

identify.command: Inspect connections, request rate, resources, and HTTP latency
identify.expected_evidence: Abnormal load coincides with saturation and failures.

resolution: Block/rate-limit abusive traffic and restore capacity.

verification.command: Repeat normal HTTP checks while monitoring load
verification.expected_result: Legitimate requests succeed without saturation.
